product.title: Pearl Harbor, Dole, and Polynesian Cultural Center from Waikiki

description.text: A small-group day from Waikiki visits Pearl Harbor, the Dole Plantation, and the Polynesian Cultural Center. Pearl Harbor covers World War II history in the United States, the Dole Plantation covers Hawaii's pineapple industry, and the Polynesian Cultural Center covers traditions in Hawaii and across the Pacific. Round-trip transportation from Waikiki hotels is included, and admission is included in the tour price. All three stops are on Oahu, and the day returns to the hotel. Waikiki hotel transfers are round trip.
